writer.name: Claude Opus 5.5, the hypnosis guide lane's writer (the splices and their fixes; the words are Emulate's)

findings.label: B2 contrast
examples: It’s one person doing three jobs rather than getting three more people to move in with you to help with the rent!
findings.reason: The contrast is his own joke from his inner child guide ("one grown-up doing three jobs, not three more people moving in to help with the rent"), as Emulate put it; it is the point of the sentence, not a framing device.

findings.label: B7 short landing at paragraph end
examples: Each job keeps the others in balance.
findings.reason: The linter sees the draft alone. In the article it is not the paragraph's end (his "It’s you that needs to develop these qualities." follows), and its words are his own, from his inner child guide: "each job keeps the others in balance".

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is Emulate's rewrite of his sentence, so it follows his points in order by design (one person, three jobs, not three more people for the rent, the balance); the turns are Emulate's own ("rather than getting", "move in with you", "!").
